parsed.notes: The filing states only that the company was in compliance with the leverage and interest coverage covenants as of September 30, 2026. It does not give the actual ratios or the covenant thresholds. Direction is inferred from the type of covenant: leverage is a maximum and interest coverage is a minimum. The consolidated net leverage ratio and consolidated leverage ratio mentioned for the interest margin and unused commitment fee only set pricing, so they are not included as covenants.
